description: This file defines functions and types related to classifying tool approval levels in an access control policy system, including resolving tool names, paths, and determining approval classes based on tool IDs and context.

classes.name: AcpApprovalClass
classes.description: Type representing different approval categories for tools.

classes.name: AcpApprovalClassification
classes.description: Type representing the classification result for a tool, including name, approval class, and auto-approval flag.

methods.name: asRecord
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a Record<string, unknown> if possible.

methods.name: readFirstStringValue
methods.description: Reads the first string value from a source object given a list of keys.

methods.name: normalizeToolName
methods.description: Normalizes a tool name string by trimming, lowercasing, and validating characters.

methods.name: parseToolNameFromTitle
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes a tool name from a title string.

methods.name: resolveToolNameForPermission
methods.description: Resolves the tool name from a tool call's metadata, raw input, or title.

methods.name: extractPathFromToolTitle
methods.description: Extracts a file path from a tool title string.

methods.name: resolveToolPathCandidate
methods.description: Resolves a potential file path from raw input or title.

methods.name: resolveAbsoluteScopedPath
methods.description: Converts a relative or special path to an absolute path based on current working directory.

methods.name: isReadToolCallScopedToCwd
methods.description: Checks if a 'read' tool call is scoped within the current working directory.

methods.name: classifyAcpToolApproval
methods.description: Classifies a tool call into an approval class with auto-approval decision based on context and tool ID.
